description: GET /v1/info lists capabilities offered on the x402 channel under x402_capabilities, apart from the dvmkit-protocol capabilities map, because one name may be a different definition on each channel. Each entry is the capabilities entry shape, with input_schema the route's flat body (no signed-request fields), plus url: the POST route a stock x402 client pays at, the public origin, then the host's mount prefix, then /v1/x402/<name>. The key is omitted when no capability is offered on x402. This example is a DVM mounted at mountPrefix behind origin with a /v1/job fetch ($0.05) and an x402-only fetch ($0.016).
